resize: short-side resize and center crop; bilinear RGB, nearest depth
timestamp_pairing: nearest depth within 0.02 seconds; depth frame reuse allowed (legacy adapter)
state: reset at each clip boundary; otherwise carry; keyframe period 30
gt_validity: finite GT and depth > 0 after sensor sentinel removal; no extra upper cutoff
prediction_clipping: none in metric panel; legacy disparity conversion uses floor 0.001 and reports failures
nonfinite_prediction: explicit error; never silently omit pixels or clips
unreadable_clip: retry same clip, then fail; no random replacement
statistics: pixel pooled within source, equal source mean; also clip mean/median/P95 and failures
tail_definition: balanced P95 is the mean of source P95s, not a global quantile
temporal: clip gauge or no fit; per-frame GT fitting is a shape diagnostic only
activity: report all-frame and post-first-frame means separately
resolution_comparison: separate common-input target 256 (report processor actual size) and official-input panels; score at 256
legacy_results: development evidence; snapshots taken now cannot prove historical execution provenance
final_test: reserved TUM moving-camera sequences; no model inference in preparation steps 1-4
